summary: B2Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K reporting the completion of the sale of its 70% interest in Fingold Ventures Ltd. to Agnico Eagle Mines Limited. The transaction closed on April 23, 2026, with B2Gold receiving US$325 million in cash proceeds. No board recommendation or advisor is named in the excerpt. The sale was previously announced on April 20, 2026, and this filing marks the closing. B2Gold will collaborate with Agnico Eagle under a Nunavut Collaboration Agreement. Watch for future updates on the use of proceeds and any implications for B2Gold's remaining portfolio.
